title: The Most Passive Online Business No One Talks About
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
If you want to learn more about launching directories, my friend Frey has a community for people serious about building one. He does weekly livestreams and holds your hand through the whole process. Learn more here: https://ship-your-directory.circle.so/checkout/syd-pro?affiliate_code=7f6f75

We go even deeper on directories on my interview with him here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1fTGX4sLVqA&list=PL5doEXwy4gHUNQg6K3CZlrmvAnKBsOePt&index=2

Check out my newsletter at https://TKOPOD.com and join my new community at https://TKOwners.com
━

I sat down to share one of the most profitable and underutilized online business models right now directory websites. These are traffic machines that can rank fast with zero backlinks and start making money through affiliate links paid placements ads and lead generation. I walk you through how to find high search volume low competition keywords using Ahrefs Reddit and Facebook groups then show how to validate the idea and launch your MVP in 24 hours without code or an audience. This is real search demand that no one's organizing and it's a blueprint for building recurring revenue with zero fulfillment. At the end I break down five money making niches I’d build today including commercial kitchen rentals and mobile dog groomers in rural areas. If you want passive income and a high margin online business this is the playbook.

Timestamps below. Enjoy!
